ruleDefinitions.name: Imports Registry Key From a File
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the import of the specified file to the registry with regedit.exe.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\regedit\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "REGEDIT\.EXE") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/i\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/s\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.reg.*"))) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-e\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-a\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ .*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(":[^ \]"))
